# QMD Usage and Querying

## How to talk to the graph
Even before a dedicated UI exists, you can query this graph by asking for:
- pages by object
- pages by track
- pages by plane
- pages by provenance
- pages related to a specific file
- all backlinks or all imports for a concept

## Example asks
- "show me all code-session pages"
- "what planning pages touch host bindings?"
- "what imports influenced the graph knowledge system?"
- "what canon pages define review and chronicle?"
- "which pages are repo-read and code-vapp related?"

## Why QMD helps
Once the folder uses frontmatter consistently, these become much easier to answer with simple metadata searches and later with rendered listings.
